# Shanmugam R — Frontend Developer Portfolio

> Frontend Developer with 2+ years of production experience in React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript. Based in Chennai, India. Immediate joiner.

## About

Shanmugam R is a Frontend Developer specialising in React.js and Next.js. He has shipped government-scale web applications for the Government of Telangana and SaaS recruitment products. Before switching to software engineering, he spent 6 years as an Operations Team Leader and Safety Spoke at Michelin India, giving him strong ownership, process discipline, and structured problem-solving skills.

## Skills

- Languages: JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3
- Frameworks: React.js, Next.js, Angular.js, Redux, Context API
- Styling: Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Ant Design, Material UI
- Tools: Git, AWS Amplify, AWS S3, Vercel, Firebase, Postman
- Security: XSS prevention, Content Security Policy (CSP)
- Other: REST APIs, Formik, Chart.js, ExcelJS, SEO, Google Analytics
